title: DiBS：扩散模型引导的数独分支选择
summary: 提出DiBS方法，将扩散模型作为分支排序指南，结合符号求解器的完备性与学习型引导，显著降低数独求解的搜索成本，尤其在困难实例上效果突出。
summary_en: Proposes DiBS, a diffusion model-guided branch selection approach that combines symbolic solver completeness with learned guidance, significantly reducing search cost on Sudoku, especially on hard instances.
